name: Tadatomo
source: A member of the Hakkenshi, the Eight Dog Warriors, and a ninja by trade. Though contracted with the elusive Akasaka Agents, a fateful meeting brought Tadatomo to the Protagonist whom he swore loyalty to as his eternal Lord and vowed to protect them with his life.
